changeSet.sql:
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[Rule_AfterDelete] GO
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[Rule_AfterInsert] GO
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [dbo].[Rule_AfterUpdate] GO
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_Rule_RuleType') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Rule] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_Rule_RuleType] end GO
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[Rule]') AND type in (N'U')) DROP TABLE [dbo].[Rule] GO
